method: Direct observation of the live layout by the account owner, reported with screenshots. No automation reads these fields: the readonly preflight reports source hashes and bindings only, which is why they stood at not_run in the 2026-08-01 evidence.
scope: Closes the three remaining R1 gates. Does not re-measure sources, bindings or compile hashes -- those are carried by artifacts/governance/smc_r1_live_rollout_evidence_2026-08-01.json and were independently re-verified read-only at 18:50:26Z (9/9 consumers, 0 mismatches, 11 sources, 0 drifted).

alertConditionInventory.readFrom: The alert dialog's SECOND selector, below the indicator picker. The first selector lists the chart's studies, not the conditions.
alertConditionInventory.genericEntriesNote: TradingView's own plot-based conditions. They are not declared by the scripts and are not part of the contract.

layoutInventory.evidence: The alert dialog's indicator selector enumerates every study on the chart. It listed Price plus exactly three scripts, with their TradingView versions: SMC Long-Dip Suite v48.0, SMC Event Overlay v7.0, SMC Exit Signal v1.0.

instanceCountsMeasured.source: Run 30710010604 logged script-remove-ok SMC Event Overlay:1->0 and SMC Exit Signal:1->0 before the rollback drill removed them, and the restore re-inserts exactly one via refreshChartScriptInstance, which clears all visible instances first.
instanceCountsMeasured.whyItWasChecked: The selector renders SMC Exit Signal as 'SMC Exit Signal (2)'. The (2) is the input summary of defensive_grace_bars = input.int(2, ...), not a second instance; the nine BUS inputs carry display = display.none and never reach the title.

compileEvidence: Hard reload (Cmd+Shift+R), waited for the chart to draw fully, then read each legend entry. No error badge on any of the three scripts.
alertMutationEvidence: Every dialog was closed with Cancel. The inventory was read, not built.

observedCaution.surface: TradingView alert dialog header, orange exclamation
observedCaution.text: This alert may function differently than expected. This is due to calculations being based on an indicator or strategy that can get repainted.
observedCaution.repositoryMitigation: Both companions gate every alertcondition() on bar close. SMC_Exit_Signal.pine: bool eval_now = (not confirm_bars_only) or barstate.isconfirmed, with confirm_bars_only defaulting to true, and _alertGate = eval_now. SMC_Event_Overlay.pine: _alertGate = barCloseOnly ? barstate.isconfirmed : true. tests/test_pine_alert_bar_close_gate.py pins this. The dialog's own Trigger read 'Once per bar close'.
observedCaution.notDetermined: Whether TradingView emits this caution for every custom-script alert or from a specific detection. It appeared for all three scripts, which is consistent with a blanket notice but does not establish one. NOT measured, so NOT claimed. A one-click check would settle it: select Price in the first selector and see whether the caution disappears.
observedCaution.treatment: Recorded as a disclosed observation, not an open gate. It reports a property of alerting on custom scripts; it does not contradict any field this artifact attests.
